## Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is. Include the command run and any unexpected errors.

## Command & Arguments
Please share the exact command you executed (with credentials masked):
```bash
rds-cli <command> --arguments
```

## Error Output & Traceback
If applicable, paste the terminal output or log dump showing the error:
```text
(Paste error log or python traceback here)
```

## Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen instead.

## Environment & Versions
- **rds-cli version:** (Check with `rds-cli --help` or inside `pyproject.toml`)
- **Python version:** (e.g. `python3 --version`)
- **OS / Distribution:** (e.g. Ubuntu 22.04, macOS Sonoma, WSL2)
- **VPN Active:** [Yes / No] (Are you connected to the UCR VPN / campus network?)

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g. large file size, satellite network connection, specific directory structure).
